name: PMN J0029-7228
notes: Real ATCA H I 21-cm absorption spectrum toward the extragalactic radio source PMN J0029-7228, from CSIRO's Data Access Portal (collection 44763, data product 56857359). The archive column is normalised absorption (1.0 = no absorption) on a 1 km/s velocity grid; pipeline/votable_to_spectrum.py converts it to optical depth tau = -ln(opacity) with sigma_tau = sigma_opacity/opacity and writes a FREQ-GHz FITS spectrum with RESTFRQ = 1420.405751 MHz. This is the repository's only cm-band (below 30 GHz) real dataset.
